source.author: verg
source.text: Gelidus Teucris per dura cucurrit ossa tremor, funditque preces rex pectore ab imo:
source.text_original: Gelidus Teucris per dura cucurrit / ossa tremor, funditque preces rex pectore ab imo: /
source.text_english: A chilling shudder ran through the hard bones of the Teucrians, and the king pours out prayers from the depths of his heart:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces:
reuse.text_original: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati / intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces: /
reuse.text_english: But the father of the Scythian son was not likewise fearless amid the danger, and the Sun pours forth such words from his heart:
